summary: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships support postdoctoral researchers in the life sciences. Applications are accepted throughout the year and evaluated at two cutoffs. Applications completed by the next cutoff, 22 January 2027 at 14:00 CET, enter the Spring Selection Round, with results at the end of June. The host country and city depend on the host lab.
highlights: For postdoctoral researchers in the life sciences.
Applications are accepted all year, with two evaluation cutoffs.
Next cutoff: 22 January 2027 at 14:00 CET, for the Spring Selection Round.
Results of the Spring Selection Round are announced at the end of June.
A host lab may support one candidate per selection round.
